pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [198, 764, 292, 998] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian is simply walking along the sidewalk in a commercial area with no intention to cross, as evidenced by their consistent parallel movement, lack of attention to traffic, and absence of any crossing infrastructure.
